CE160.message: "{{agentId}}" grants "{{capability}}", which the runtime harness "{{runtimeHarness}}" cannot serve
CE160.hint: set the runtime harness to claude-code or codex, or drop the search grant

CE102.message: "{{agentId}}" grants itself in its Uses line; an agent never depends on itself

CE103.message: "{{path}}" appears more than once in the Uses line
CE103.hint: keep a single entry per grant

CE101.message: Uses names "{{path}}": no agent of that id is in the workspace, none is deployed, and the registry has no package by that name

CE104.message: "{{path}}" is a worker and cannot appear in a Uses line
CE104.hint: if others depend on it, say in its spec that it is called and keeps its state between calls, or drop the grant

CE152.message: a worker has no tests: it is a program the plane starts, and its run is its proof
CE152.hint: drop the ## Tests section, or, if others call it, say so in its spec

CE182.message: an interface has no Uses line: it compiles to a contract and nothing else, so it reaches nothing
CE182.hint: drop the Uses line; grants belong to the implementors and consumers

CE183.message: an interface does not implement another interface (no composition in v1)

CE181.message: a worker implements nothing: it has no handlers for an interface to pin
CE181.hint: drop the Implements line, or if others call it, say so in its spec (an agent others call is a task, or keeps state between calls)

CE180.message: "{{agentId}}" implements itself; an agent conforms to an interface, never to its own id

CE180.2.message: Implements names "{{target}}", which is a {{type}}, not an interface
CE180.2.hint: an Implements target is a spec that only defines a contract others implement; to call an agent, grant it on the Uses line instead

CE180.3.message: Implements names "{{target}}" but no spec exists at that path under the agents root

CE161.message: "{{agentId}}" and "{{holder}}" would both serve as "{{serviceName}}" on the substrate
CE161.hint: rename one; service names replace every non-alphanumeric character with an underscore

CE162.message: "{{agentId}}" is installed from a package; a workspace file may not shadow an installed package
CE162.hint: remove the install, or move your spec to another id

CE170.message: file:{{written}} resolves outside the agents root (or to the root itself); only files under the root are uploaded with the workspace
CE170.hint: move the file under the agents root and grant it by a path relative to the spec, or from the root with a leading slash

CE171.message: file:{{written}} names no file or folder at {{rel}}
CE171.hint: the path is relative to the spec, or from the agents root when it starts with a slash

CE172.message: file:{{written}} is {{folder}} ({{rel}}); the upload carries regular files only
CE172.hint: replace it with the file itself

CE172.2.hint: put files in it or drop the grant

CE174.message: {{sep}} is {{large}}, past the {{MAX_ASSET_BYTES}} cap on one granted file
CE174.hint: keep large data in a dependency that owns storage

CE173.message: file:{{written}} and file:{{holder}} would both be exported as "{{name}}" by ./assets.js
CE173.hint: rename one of them; the export name comes from the file or folder name

CE106.message: "{{agentId}}" uses "{{path}}", which is deployed and uses "{{agentId}}" back through the fleet ({{loop}}): a cycle
CE106.hint: break the loop: one of the two must stop using the other, or the shared part becomes a third agent both use

CE190.hint: the target is a path relative to the spec (or from the agents root with a leading slash) to a file that exists, or an https url

CE191.message: "{{agentId}}" implements more than one openapi document; one document per agent
CE191.hint: merge the paths into one document, or split the agent

CE237.message: Mocks names "{{agentId}}", which cannot be mocked: {{reason}}
CE237.hint: list an agent, a module or an interface this agent's own Uses names; the agent itself is never mocked

CE238.message: an interface's ## Tests section may not list Mocks: the section applies at every implementor's compile, whose edges it cannot know
CE238.hint: list the mocks in each implementor's own Tests section

CE243.message: Mocks names "{{agentId}}", which is not an agent this agent's tests could reach
CE243.hint: a mock stands in for an agent this agent uses: an agent or an interface its own Uses names, in this workspace, installed, or an agent of the fleet
